name: cruscotto
description: Instrument strip above the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly limits, range to the reset, total tokens and their API value, five lamps and prompt buttons.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: The look of the strip: night (dark themes), amber (one-color amber cluster), paper (light themes) or mono.

warnAt.title: Amber threshold (%)
warnAt.description: A bar turns amber, and the lamp with it, when this share of its window or less is left.

badAt.title: Red threshold (%)
badAt.description: A bar turns red, and the lamp with it, when this share of its window or less is left.

lamps.title: Lamps
lamps.description: Show the five lamps on the bottom row: failed turn, cold cache, tools running, agents running, turbo.

coldCacheBelow.title: Cold cache lamp (%)
coldCacheBelow.description: The cold lamp lights amber when the cache hit of the last turn is under this share.

turboAt.title: Turbo lamp (tokens/min)
turboAt.description: The turbo lamp lights when the token rate of the last 5 minutes reaches this; 0 turns it off.

buttons.title: Prompt buttons
buttons.description: Show the three built-in prompt buttons.

buttonsFile.title: Your buttons
buttonsFile.description: A Markdown file with your own buttons: each `## Label` heading starts one, the lines under it are the prompt it sends. Hotkeys 1 to 9 in order.
